suggestions.assertion: No more than 8 issues are reported.
suggestions.reason: This cap is in tension with the fixture: it plants at least 9 genuine defects (both the with-skill and without-skill runs independently found 9+ real issues, all verified against source). As written, the assertion penalizes completeness — this run failed it only by adding a Low housekeeping entry on top of 8 substantive findings. Either raise the cap, restrict the count to Critical/High, or make the fixture's defect count fit under the cap.

suggestions.assertion: The reviewed diff is the branch vs main (merge-base or 'against main' language; not just the last commit alone and not an unrelated baseline).
suggestions.reason: The fixture branch is exactly one commit ahead of main, so 'last commit alone' and 'branch vs main' produce identical diffs — the assertion cannot discriminate the failure mode it names. A two-commit feature branch would make it a real test.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are mostly well-targeted and verifiable from the report alone; the issue-count cap conflicts with the planted-defect count and the 1-commit fixture weakens the baseline-selection check.
